::: {#def-graph-generator .theorem}
# Graph generator

A graph generator gives the entries of a random graph with $n$ nodes. It is an $n \times n$ array of structural equations $[f_{\psi_{ij}}]_{i,j \in \mathcal N}$ whose entries $\psi(i,j)$ are each a deterministic function of other variables in the model and an error term:

$$
\psi(i,j) = f_{\psi_{ij}}\big(\mathbf{Pa}(\psi(i,j)), U_{\psi_{ij}}\big).
$$

Because a [graph](#def-graph) has $\psi(i,j)=\psi(j,i)$, the array is assumed symmetric in its indices: $U_{\psi_{ij}} = U_{\psi_{ji}}$ and $f_{\psi_{ij}} = f_{\psi_{ji}}$.
:::
